text:
ana: Quick sync — we need a tight benchmark narrative for the launch. Goal: one clear homepage chart, two deeper visuals for the webinar, and a routing + CTA plan so marketing -> SDRs converts. Can everyone drop one recommendation? :sparkles:

kevin: Suggestion: lead with 'unit economics' headline — show cost per 1k requests at live latency bands. Messaging: 'Same quality, up to X% cheaper or Yx lower latency' depending on slice. Keep the homepage = single stat + simple chart.

maria: Chart options (high level):
- Chart A: stacked band chart showing p50/p95/p99 latency across model variants with a secondary axis for $/1k tokens. Good for explaining tradeoffs.
- Chart B: scatter of latency vs cost with iso-cost contour lines (puts value choices front-and-center).
- Chart C: small-multiples: three workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings) each with a sparkline + numeric delta to baseline. Good for hero & deep-dive slides.
```
# quick sketch (not for prod)
A: x=sequence length, y=latency ms, fill=p50-p99, y2=$/1k tokens
B: x=latency_ms, y=$/1k, point=size=throughput
```

sam: For conversion, homepage should be explicit CTA per slice: "Try latency-optimised" vs "Try cost-optimised". Click -> segmented landing pages. Webinar CTA: "See live slicing → reserve a seat" + gating form with use-case selector.

lee: Data notes from infra: p99 moves a lot depending on batching. If we show p99, we need to call out test rig (seq len distribution, batching window). Otherwise use p95 + band to avoid finger-pointing. Also can surface median latency for hero stat.

ana: +1 on p95 median combo. We should avoid p99 as the headline metric. Use p50/p95 in the hero breakdown, and deeper appendix with p99 and test config.

maria: Visual asks: if we pick scatter (B) for webinar, I need raw CSV: columns [model, latency_p50, latency_p95, cost_per_1k, throughput]. Lee can you confirm headers and a stable export?

lee: I can export that. Will include test metadata in a JSON sidecar. ETA Thu EOD. Note: include both dedicated and hosted runs so we can show routing fallbacks.

sam: Routing rules (first pass):
- webinar signup + "enterprise" use-case => AE lead + include dedicated capacity playbook PDF
- webinar signup + "startup/smb" => SDR nurture track with self-serve credits + one-pager
- demo requests with usage > 500k tokens/mo => sales alert, prioritized routing
We should A/B test CTA phrasing: "See latency in action" vs "Cut inference costs" and route on which they pick.

ana: Love the A/B test idea. Also want a short two-sentence positioning for PR/LinkedIn: "Redwood Inference reduces inference unit costs while preserving latency for production apps. We benchmarked common workloads and show predictable economics across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Keep it simple.

maria: Design checklist: color palette (green = cost wins, purple = latency wins), axis labels (ms, $/1k tokens), accessible fonts, and annotated deltas for calls-to-action. Will prototype 3 variants by Fri morning.

lee: One more engineering caveat: when we quote $/1k tokens, specify whether it's raw token cost or includes infra overhead. Recommend a small footnote: "Includes average infra overhead and batching savings from our serving runtime."

deploy-bot: Reminder: landing page prototype slated for staging deploy on 1976570000. Please file PRs against `marketing/bench-landing` by Thu 18:00 UTC. :robot_face:

ana: OK—action items: Maria -> 3 prototypes (hero + webinar) by Fri AM; Lee -> CSV + meta by Thu EOD; Sam -> draft routing rules + CTA variants for A/B test; Kevin -> finalize headline wording; I'll compile assets and draft the LinkedIn copy. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
